title: Hearty Chinese Noodles Dan Dan Mian
description: A pungent and cozy Chinese dish featuring sesame seeds, this low-carb-friendly dan dan mian is perfect for a cold winter night, served in a traditional donabe vessel.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the Chinese noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and chili oil to make the sauce.
In a large skillet or wok, cook the ground pork over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir the sauce into the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a donabe or large serving bowl.
Sprinkle the toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions over the top of the noodles.
Serve immediately, with additional chili oil and soy sauce on the side if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
